name: promptpad-note
description: Pluggable & Headless Note & Prompt Management for Node.js (MongoDB) and React

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
